findings.title: Low ground plane fill ratio
findings.description: Ground zone on B.Cu has 15% fill ratio. Excessive routing or thermal relief patterns may be reducing ground plane effectiveness.
findings.recommendation: Reduce routing density on this layer or move signals to other layers.
findings.summary: Low ground plane fill ratio

findings.title: Decoupling cap moderately far from U2
findings.description: Nearest decoupling cap to U2 (AP2112K-3.3) is 5.5mm away. Recommended: <3mm for best high-frequency performance.
findings.recommendation: Move decoupling cap closer to U2 power pins if layout permits.
findings.summary: Decoupling cap moderately far from U2

findings.title: No decoupling cap found near U3
findings.description: U3 (ESP32-C3_SUPERMINI_TH) has no capacitor within 10mm. Every IC with power pins needs at least one decoupling capacitor.
findings.recommendation: Add 100nF X7R 0402 + 1µF X5R 0603 close to U3 power pins. For high-speed ICs, add 10nF C0G for high-frequency decoupling. Place caps on the same side as U3 with short, wide traces to vias.
findings.summary: No decoupling cap found near U3

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J3
findings.description: Connector J3 (UART_DEBUG_PROGRAM) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J3. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.
findings.summary: No EMC filtering near J3

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers F.Cu and In1.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: F.Cu, In1.Cu

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: In1.Cu, In2.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers In1.Cu and In2.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: In1.Cu, In2.Cu

findings.title: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu
findings.description: Signal layers In2.Cu and B.Cu are adjacent without a reference plane between them. This causes high crosstalk and poor return path control for signals on both layers.
findings.recommendation: Reorder stackup to place a ground or power plane between every pair of signal layers.
findings.summary: Adjacent signal layers: In2.Cu, B.Cu

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (58×50mm, εr=4.5) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1215 MHz; (0,1) at 1413 MHz; (1,1) at 1863 MHz; (2,0) at 2430 MHz; (2,1) at 2811 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.
findings.summary: Board cavity resonance frequencies

findings.title: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /SYS_RAW
findings.description: Net /SYS_RAW has 6 layer transition(s) across B.Cu, F.Cu, In2.Cu. 6 transition(s) have no ground stitching via within 1.0mm. The return current must find an alternate path, creating a loop antenna.
findings.recommendation: Add a ground stitching via within 1.0mm of each signal via. Place the ground via adjacent to the signal via on the same pad cluster.
findings.summary: Missing stitching via at layer transition: /SYS_RAW

findings.title: 3V3 PDN anti-resonance exceeds target
findings.description: U2 (AP2112K-3.3) 3V3 rail (analytical): target impedance 0.165Ω (Vout=3.3V, 5% ripple, 1.0A transient). Anti-resonance peak(s) exceed target at: 363.1 MHz (0.23Ω). Decoupling: 4 caps (C3 10.0µF, C2 1.0µF, C4 0.1µF, C5 0.1µF).
findings.recommendation: Add 270pF 0603 MLCC near the IC power pins (SRF ≈ 363.1MHz fills the anti-resonance gap). (analytical — verify with SPICE if available)
findings.summary: 3V3 PDN anti-resonance exceeds target
